description: Classification of every key of the vendored exact_check_results.json (PLAN component E, "A portable exact gate", R09; H2 checklist step 7). exact: compared by JSON equality with the vendored results file, every one required. float_diagnostics: each checked against its bound, the value reported, never compared for equality. provenance: matched by pattern, never compared; recorded in exact_check_provenance.json with the environment. A key in none of the three classes, a newly appeared key or a missing exact key fails the gate (tests/assembly_checks.py --exact).

notes: H2 review minor note (derivation and handoff-tests lenses): the live-RECON key embeds the md5 of the live RECON.md, so a rerun after any RECON edit creates a new key name; it is provenance, matched by pattern. The embedded-copy key "19683 C8 of C62d LRI_C8_D2_HPC_loop/RECON.md:91-95 (md5 3bb715b1... on 2026-10-03)" carries a fixed md5 inside exact_check.py and is exact.

The ms7 key embeds the md5 of the fixture check_assembly.py (f3c72eec...); it is exact and required. exact_check.py omits it silently when LRI_ROOT lacks the file, so a missing fixture fails the gate here.
The C63d-recon keys carry fixed md5s inside exact_check.py and are exact.
